offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures ceiling and wall systems, including mineral fiber and metal ceilings, for commercial and institutional buildings. Sells mainly through distributors to contractors, with products made in North American plants and from purchased materials.

primary_products.value: mineral fiber ceiling tiles; metal ceiling panels; suspension systems and grid; specialty architectural ceilings and wall systems; wood and acoustic ceiling solutions

customer_segment.value: B2B: distributors, installing contractors, architects, building owners and facility managers

end_markets.value: commercial construction; education; healthcare; office; retail; renovation

revenue_model.value: product sales: ceiling and wall systems sold to distributors and contractors for new construction and renovation

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures ceiling tiles, grid and metal panels from purchased and processed materials, sold to distributors and contractors

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with some sales in Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: mineral fiber ceilings, metal ceilings, suspension systems and architectural specialty products

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent ceiling and building product distributors serving contractors; direct sales: specialty architectural ceilings sold to contractors and project specifiers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building fire, safety and environmental codes, manufacturing environmental and workplace rules

notes: Residential flooring business was sold; description reflects ceiling-focused business. Details of geography are approximate.
